title: Law to require probation to explain court process to accused youth
summary: This bill would require the city's Department of Probation to give young people accused of crimes, and their parents or guardians, a notice explaining the criminal legal process, including how cases might be adjusted, referred for prosecution or sentenced, and listing organizations that provide legal help. It would also require probation officers to read youth their rights before an intake interview, including that their statements cannot be shared with prosecutors or used as evidence before conviction. The law would take effect 90 days after passage.
